title: Place search request flow
subtitle: The app never holds the geocoding key. The provider sees SafeRoute's server, not the user. Nothing about a search is logged or stored (P011a, ADR 0018)

nodes.label: App: GET /v1/search with q, a coarse map area and a Firebase ID token
requireUser: verify the token, load the account (401, 403)
Validate and normalise q: NFC, 2 to 100 code points, no control characters, joiners kept (400)
Coarsen near to 2 decimals (about 1 km); default bias if absent
Rate limiter, in order: user burst (30, then 1/s), user daily (1000), shared provider budget
PostgreSQL rate_limit_buckets: one row per bucket, one atomic statement, database time
Provider adapter, chosen by name: adds the key, 3 s timeout, no retry, size bound, strict parsing
503 search_unavailable (+ Retry-After): shared budget used up, provider 429, timeout, network, bad body, or our key refused. Never 401 or 403
Secret Manager → Cloud Run env: GEOCODING_API_KEY. Missing in production: the API refuses to start
NEVER LOGGED OR STORED: query, coordinates, results, key. One log line per call: outcome, latency, count
Evaluation harness (local, key from the environment): fixture queries → same adapter → hit rate by district and script
